text: こわっぱ　ごときが　せっしゃに　たたかいを　いどむとは　かたはら　いたいわ！

structure.jp: こわっぱ　ごときが
せっしゃに　たたかいを　いどむとは
かたはら　いたいわ！

patterns.name: 〜とは
patterns.explanation: とは after a verb shows surprise or scorn at the fact just named: 'to think that…'. いどむとは = 'to think you would challenge me'.

patterns.name: 〜ごとき
patterns.span: こわっぱ　ごときが
patterns.explanation: ごとき after a person looks down on them: 'the likes of'. It is old-fashioned, fitting Koga's ninja speech. こわっぱ ごときが = 'the likes of a brat'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.span: かたはら　いたいわ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end here is the gruff, old-style way of pushing a statement out with force, not the feminine one. かたはら いたいわ = 'how laughable!'.
